_about: Food booking dates, merged into the trip's deadlines by the loader (src/lib/data/loader.ts) so What's next and the Food tab's Book by list show them. Built from data/food-deep/topics/calendar.json, 'Book by: the deadlines'. `place` is a food place id (<city>/<slug of its name>).

deadlines.item: Book Tokyo's one big night for 20–23 Dec or 7–8 Jan: Sushi Arai, Kagurazaka Ishikawa or Myōjaku (rooms for 6: ask about a seventh chair)
Ask Akasaka Kikunoi for 20–23 Dec (room for 6: ask whether seven fit)
Sazenka: see what's left on 20, 22 or 23 Dec (closed Mondays) and ask about seven
Book Kanazawa dinners for 27–29 Dec: Kabuna (room for 6, ask about seven) and Oden Miyuki (rooms for 10–20)
Email Yukari Sakamoto about her depachika and market tour (weekday mornings: 21–23 Dec or 8 Jan)
Otome Zushi (Kanazawa): online booking opens for dinner on 28 Dec; the tatami room takes seven
Sazenka and other 1st-of-the-month places: booking opens for January, for 7–8 Jan in Tokyo
Torishiki: phone booking opens for January (18 Nov to confirm), 17:00–19:00 Japan time, for 7–8 Jan: ask whether they take seven
Soba Fujioka (Nagano): booking opens a month ahead for lunch on 25 or 26 Dec; 6-seat table, ask about a seventh
Order a Kyoto osechi box for 1 Jan (Takashimaya, Daimaru or a ryōtei)
Kiji-tei (Kawaguchiko): book lunch on Thu 7 Jan in the private room; phone 9:00–10:00 on business days
One-month places: booking opens for January, the best window for elite Tokyo counters on 7–8 Jan
Toyosu tuna-auction deck lottery opens (about 2–8 Dec) for 7 or 8 Jan: two applications for seven (5+2 or 4+3)
Check New Year hours for the Kanazawa and Kyoto list; have the hotel phone in mid-December
Ginza Hachigo: booking opens at 9:00 for next week's seats (21–24 Dec); book two seatings (4+3)
Konbini osechi: FamilyMart by 22 Dec, Lawson by about 25 Dec, 7-Eleven by 28 Dec
Phone Izuu from 08:00 for saba-zushi to collect in Kyoto on 30 or 31 Dec
Matsuba nishin soba this afternoon, or at opening on the 31st
